findings.title: Guard against a vacuous selection test
findings.text:
The assertion only catches the regression if `corpus_set=parity_and_adversarial` actually changes the applying count
versus the default context; if the selector is inert, both runs report the same number and the test passes even with the
bug reintroduced. Add a bare `propose` run and assert its count differs from the selector run, so the test premise is
proven rather than assumed.

findings.title: Make CLI tests hermetic from ambient root
findings.text:
The spawned binary inherits the ambient environment, so a CI-provided `REQ_ROOT` would redirect corpus resolution away
from `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR` and make these tests silently measure a different corpus. Clear `REQ_ROOT` in the helper so
the corpus is resolved solely from the crate root, independent of the environment that invoked `cargo test`.

findings.title: Verify gold fixture before invoking
findings.text:
If `bench/corpus/tier2-v1.yml` is missing or untracked, this test fails on the `"Tier-2 funnel"` assertion and reports a
parser failure instead of the real cause. Assert the fixture exists before invoking the binary, using an absolute path
anchored at `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`, so a missing file is diagnosed as a fixture problem.
